semantic_comparisons.reason: Purity spends its own amplifier budget to decrement harmful statuses on the same entity. Raycat instead latches another entity, waits again, requests recipient gain before independently reducing that other entity current status.

Mekanism consumes equipment energy to advance durations and handle hidden rollover. Raycat does not pay that resource or advance durations; it attempts a delayed cross-entity amplifier reduction with independent recipient mutations.

Antidote caps finite duration with a shared item cooldown. Raycat uses a retained ID and a second randomized wait, recipient gain first, then current target amplifier decrease rather than duration cap.

Soaked is a server event to observer-side reconstructed status copy. Raycat own gameplay tick mutates recipient and selected source independently; beam is state presentation rather than a removal acknowledgment.

Wartling stores an effect type as dynamic admission immunity and performs prehit theft. Raycat instead has delayed live-ID resolution, no stored-type canBeAffected gate, recipient gain before current-target decrement, and independent state beam.

Stashed combat charge consumption computes old amplifier then rechecks same effect type at deferred world-tail mutation. No latched external source status and independent recipient radiation/heal-before-source-reduction family.

Deferred AI-control eligibility is revalidated and successful brainwash preparation qualifies cost/cue. Raycat has a second wait without those final gates and independently settles recipient/source statuses.
Lifeleak converts a canceled incoming attack into heal of its target. It does not delay and transfer/reduce a selected second entity effect amplifier.
Sting-qualified source refusal and observer reconstruction from two IDs differs from Raycat delayed status transfer attempt and state beam.

observations: Actual RAYCAT entity/attribute/renderer and IRRADIATED registry entries bind the producer and consumers; mod constructor registers entity/effect registries and CommonEvents. These are source binding, not loaded runtime registry proof.

Native tick decrements local unsynced absorbCooldown before selection. Only after it is already <=0 does server selection prefer the irradiated owner strictly within20, else nearest qualifying Living in an inflated9 box, excluding Raycat and untamed selection of Player. Latching the integer ID immediately resets cooldown300..599: a retained target must wait that second interval before progress starts.

At resolved target and expired cooldown, amount<=0 starts1 and requests sound; subsequent ticks decrement .05. At completion currentRad is read from recipient, heal10 requested, then IRRADIATED200/currentRad requested, then lookAt, then current target status read/removed and amplifier>0 recreated with same remaining duration and amplifier-1. Recipient mutations precede source mutations.

No explicit alive/range/LOS/effect/ownership revalidation guards completion. getAbsorbTarget resolves any Entity in current level by integer ID; completion recipient gain is still requested if it is not Living or no longer owns the effect. addEffect/removeEffect return values are ignored; heal is a request without checking resulting health. This is not atomic transfer or successful removal acknowledgment.

When ID resolution becomes null, selection/reset path does not clear absorb amount. A later target can inherit partial progress after its fresh cooldown; the renderer itself has no cooldown or source-effect gate. Completion clears ID and server resets cooldown even if source reduction did not occur.

Only target selection and final cooldown reset have explicit server guards in this branch; progress and recipient/source mutation lack a surrounding server-only guard. Cooldown is local and randomized per entity construction. No authoritative settlement or client/server convergence is established.

Complete IrradiatedEffect excludes Raycat specifically from its radiation hurt production, not from status possession or all damage. Raycat own tick requests heal1 each10 entity ticks while IRRADIATED is present. Complete registered livingHeal listener cancels irradiated healing unless entity type RESISTS_RADIATION; fixed actual tag includes raycat, bypassing only that listener condition, not every later healing rule.

Exact Irradiated scheduling: level<=0 returns false; for positive level, integer j=200/level; if j>1 callback qualifies at tick1%j==j/2, otherwise returns true each tick. j can be1 or0 and neither path performs modulo0. Do not call j=0 a zero-period schedule.

Entity owns explicit NBT for Command and LayTime only; ID/amount/cooldown have no own save/load keys. Do not call this a durable transaction. Command text in mobInteract reports sit/follow commands rather than transfer or refusal success.

Complete renderer draws green fullbright beam from amount>0, Raycat alive and non-null target; it does not inspect successful removal, recipient status admission or heal outcome. Radiation shader request is independent of transfer and excluded only by sepia/config branch. Ordinary body/eyes and sit/lay pose lack an outcome-specific gate. Render helper properties are source calls, not pixels or transport acceptance.
clarifications: 精确限定：live-target只指当前integerID解析，不代表最终isAlive/距离/LOS/归属/effect资格复验。heal/add/remove/add均为请求，接收方先请求获益再独立处理源方减层，不验最终结果。Irradiated调度level<=0直接false；正level令整数j=200/level，j>1才tick%j==j/2，否则每ticktrue；j为0不执行modulo0，也不是零周期。body radiation helper显式LEQUAL，eyes EQUAL；beam getNucleeperLights未显式设置LEQUAL，各pass不能泛化成共同depth或可见遮挡已验证。

Native constructor defaults/update-combine rules not newly expanded; no lossless-state or guaranteed amplifier increment claim.

Normal completion clears id and consumes server cooldown even if transfer did not change source. Because recipient effect may already exist with different strength/duration, addEffect call is not proof exactly200 or a stronger resulting status. Healing may be capped/canceled by independent rules.
